```{r Load packages}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r Load data}
# Compact helper function to read raw CSVs
bee_data <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", "bee_data.csv"),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

###############################################################
# 1. Detect species columns (format: "Genus species")
###############################################################

species_cols <- names(bee_data)[
  str_detect(names(bee_data), "^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[a-z]+")
]

cat("Species columns detected:", length(species_cols), "\n")

###############################################################
# 2. Collapse repeated visits → one row per plot
###############################################################

plot_level <- bee_data %>%
  group_by(region, site, plotID) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(species_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

###############################################################
# 3. Convert abundances to presence/absence
###############################################################

plot_level[species_cols] <- (plot_level[species_cols] > 0) * 1

###############################################################
# 4. Extract community matrix + metadata
###############################################################

comm_matrix <- as.data.frame(plot_level[, species_cols])

meta <- plot_level %>%
  select(region, site, plotID)

###############################################################
# 5. Remove empty rows (plots with zero bees)
###############################################################

empty_rows <- rowSums(comm_matrix) == 0
cat("Empty plots removed:", sum(empty_rows), "\n")

comm_matrix <- comm_matrix[!empty_rows, ]
meta <- meta[!empty_rows, ]

###############################################################
# 6. Fit NMDS on FULL dataset once (Bray on PA = Sørensen)
###############################################################

set.seed(123)

nmds <- metaMDS(
  comm_matrix,
  distance = "bray",
  k = 2,
  trymax = 200
)

cat("NMDS stress =", nmds$stress, "\n")

###############################################################
# 7. Combine NMDS scores with metadata
###############################################################

nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores <- cbind(nmds_scores, meta)

###############################################################
# 8. Faceted GGplot NMDS — one panel per region
###############################################################

ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = site)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = site), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS — Bee Species Composition by Region (Presence/Absence)",
    subtitle = paste("NMDS Stress =", round(nmds$stress, 3),
                     "• Ellipses compare focal vs control *within each region*"),
    color = "Site Type"
  )

```
```{r}

betadisp <- betadisper(vegdist(comm_matrix, method="bray"), meta$site)
anova(betadisp)

```




```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# AGGREGATE: sum species counts across visits
# within each plot — gives 64 plots
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

sp_agg <- as.data.frame(sp_matrix) %>%
  mutate(plotID = meta$plotID) %>%
  group_by(plotID) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("plotID")

meta_agg <- meta %>%
  select(plotID, site, region, plot) %>%
  distinct(plotID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Remove species never seen
sp_agg <- sp_agg[, colSums(sp_agg) > 0]

cat("Aggregated matrix:", nrow(sp_agg), "plots x", ncol(sp_agg), "species\n")
cat("Sparsity:", round(mean(sp_agg == 0) * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("Abundance range:", min(rowSums(sp_agg)), "-", max(rowSums(sp_agg)), "\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# NMDS on aggregated plot-level data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

sp_agg_hell <- decostand(sp_agg, method = "hellinger")

set.seed(42)
nmds_agg <- metaMDS(
  sp_agg_hell,
  distance      = "euclidean",
  k             = 2,
  trymax        = 200,
  autotransform = FALSE
)
cat("Stress (aggregated Hellinger):", nmds_agg$stress, "\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# PLOT aggregated NMDS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

nmds_agg_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_agg, display = "sites"))
nmds_agg_scores <- bind_cols(nmds_agg_scores, meta_agg)

ggplot(nmds_agg_scores,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2,
           colour = site, shape = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("focal" = "#2166ac", "control" = "#d73027"),
    name = "Site type"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 18), name = "Region") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
           label = paste0("Stress = ", round(nmds_agg$stress, 3)),
           size = 3.5, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2",
       title = "Bee community — NMDS aggregated across visits (plot level)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# PERMANOVA on aggregated data
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

dist_agg <- vegdist(sp_agg_hell, method = "euclidean")

permanova_agg <- adonis2(
  dist_agg ~ site + region,
  data         = meta_agg,
  permutations = 999,
  by           = "margin"
)
print(permanova_agg)

# PERMDISP
disp_agg <- betadisper(dist_agg, meta_agg$site)
print(permutest(disp_agg, permutations = 999))
plot(disp_agg, main = "Dispersion by site type (aggregated)")
```

```{r}
# 1. Try k=3 to check if stress improves meaningfully
set.seed(42)
nmds_3d <- metaMDS(sp_agg_hell, distance = "euclidean",
                   k = 3, trymax = 200, autotransform = FALSE)
cat("Stress k=3:", nmds_3d$stress, "\n")

# 2. Add envfit vectors to the aggregated NMDS
meta_agg2 <- meta_agg %>%
  left_join(
    data_all %>%
      group_by(plotID) %>%
      summarise(
        patchiness    = mean(patchiness, na.rm = TRUE),
        bee_richness  = sum(bee_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
        bee_abundance = sum(bee_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
        hill_q0       = mean(hill_q0, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "plotID"
  )

ef_agg <- envfit(
  ord          = nmds_agg,
  env          = meta_agg2 %>% select(patchiness, bee_richness,
                                       bee_abundance, hill_q0),
  permutations = 999,
  na.rm        = TRUE
)
print(ef_agg)

# 3. Convex hulls on the working NMDS
hulls_agg <- nmds_agg_scores %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

ggplot(nmds_agg_scores,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, colour = site, shape = region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_polygon(
    data        = hulls_agg,
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = site, colour = site),
    alpha       = 0.1, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("focal" = "#2166ac", "control" = "#d73027"),
    name = "Site type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("focal" = "#2166ac", "control" = "#d73027"),
    name = "Site type"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 18), name = "Region") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
           label = paste0("Stress = ", round(nmds_agg$stress, 3)),
           size = 3.5, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2",
       title = "Bee community — NMDS (plot level, aggregated across visits)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# REGION-SEPARATE NMDS — aggregated plots
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

regions <- unique(meta_agg$region)

nmds_region_list  <- list()
scores_region_list <- list()

for (r in regions) {
  
  cat("\n── Region:", r, "──\n")
  
  # Subset
  idx       <- meta_agg$region == r
  sp_sub    <- sp_agg[idx, ]
  meta_sub  <- meta_agg[idx, ]
  
  # Drop species not present in this region
  sp_sub <- sp_sub[, colSums(sp_sub) > 0]
  cat("  Plots:", nrow(sp_sub), "| Species:", ncol(sp_sub), "\n")
  cat("  Sparsity:", round(mean(sp_sub == 0) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  
  # Hellinger transform
  sp_sub_hell <- decostand(sp_sub, method = "hellinger")
  
  # NMDS
  set.seed(42)
  nmds_r <- metaMDS(
    sp_sub_hell,
    distance      = "euclidean",
    k             = 2,
    trymax        = 200,
    autotransform = FALSE
  )
  cat("  Stress:", round(nmds_r$stress, 3), "\n")
  
  # PERMANOVA within region
  dist_r <- vegdist(sp_sub_hell, method = "euclidean")
  perm_r <- adonis2(dist_r ~ site, data = meta_sub,
                    permutations = 999, by = "margin")
  cat("  PERMANOVA site effect: F =",
      round(perm_r$F[1], 2),
      "R2 =", round(perm_r$R2[1], 3),
      "p =", perm_r$`Pr(>F)`[1], "\n")
  
  # Store scores
  sc <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_r, display = "sites"))
  sc$site   <- meta_sub$site
  sc$region <- r
  sc$plotID <- meta_sub$plotID
  sc$stress <- round(nmds_r$stress, 3)
  
  nmds_region_list[[r]]   <- nmds_r
  scores_region_list[[r]] <- sc
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# COMBINE SCORES AND PLOT AS FACETS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

all_region_scores <- bind_rows(scores_region_list)

# Stress label per facet
stress_labels <- all_region_scores %>%
  distinct(region, stress) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("Stress = ", stress),
         NMDS1 = Inf, NMDS2 = -Inf)

# Hulls per region x site
hulls_region <- all_region_scores %>%
  group_by(region, site) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

ggplot(all_region_scores,
       aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, colour = site)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  geom_polygon(
    data        = hulls_region,
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = site, colour = site),
    alpha       = 0.15,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data        = stress_labels,
    aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, label = label),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3, colour = "grey40",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("focal" = "#2166ac", "control" = "#d73027"),
    name   = "Site type"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("focal" = "#2166ac", "control" = "#d73027"),
    name   = "Site type"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x     = "NMDS1",
    y     = "NMDS2",
    title = "Bee community composition by region — focal vs control"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
```{r}
# Best of both worlds:
# 1. Single global NMDS (your new code) for the figure
# 2. Single global PERMANOVA with region as covariate for overall test
# 3. Per-region PERMANOVA for the regional breakdown table
# 4. Ellipses for visualisation (your new code)
# 5. Presence/absence + Sorensen (your new code)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# CHECK: are row counts aligned?
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("comm_matrix rows:", nrow(comm_matrix), "\n")
cat("meta rows:", nrow(meta), "\n")
cat("Region distribution in meta:\n")
print(table(meta$region))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# FIX 1: Replace NAs with 0 in comm_matrix
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

comm_matrix[is.na(comm_matrix)] <- 0

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# FIX 2: Rebuild meta with row index to ensure
# alignment with comm_matrix
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

# Attach region/site back to comm_matrix rows safely
comm_df <- comm_matrix
comm_df$region <- meta$region
comm_df$site   <- meta$site
comm_df$plotID <- meta$plotID

regions        <- unique(meta$region)
region_results <- list()

for (r in regions) {
  
  cat("\n── Region:", r, "──\n")
  
  # Subset rows for this region
  sub_df   <- comm_df[comm_df$region == r, ]
  meta_sub <- sub_df[, c("region", "site", "plotID")]
  sp_sub   <- sub_df[, !names(sub_df) %in% c("region", "site", "plotID")]
  
  # Drop species absent in this region
  sp_sub <- sp_sub[, colSums(sp_sub, na.rm = TRUE) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  
  cat("  Plots:", nrow(sp_sub),
      "| Species:", ncol(sp_sub), "\n")
  cat("  Sparsity:", round(mean(sp_sub == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%\n")
  
  # PERMANOVA
  dist_r <- vegdist(as.matrix(sp_sub), method = "bray", binary = TRUE)
  perm_r <- adonis2(dist_r ~ site, data = meta_sub,
                    permutations = 999)
  
  cat("  PERMANOVA: F =",  round(perm_r$F[1], 2),
      "| R2 =", round(perm_r$R2[1], 3),
      "| p =",  perm_r$`Pr(>F)`[1], "\n")
  
  region_results[[r]] <- data.frame(
    region = r,
    F_val  = round(perm_r$F[1], 2),
    R2     = round(perm_r$R2[1], 3),
    p      = perm_r$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# SUMMARY TABLE with BH correction
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

region_df       <- bind_rows(region_results)
region_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(region_df$p, method = "BH")
region_df$sig   <- case_when(
  region_df$p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
  region_df$p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
  region_df$p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
  TRUE                    ~ "ns"
)

print(region_df)
```
